description.zh:
数据类型，可多选，当前支持
- COMMON 通用
- PIC 图片
- TEXT 文本
- TABLE 表格
- VIDEO 视频
- AUDIO 音频
- INDEX 索引
description.en:
The data type. Multiple selections are allowed. Valid values:

- COMMON

- PIC

- TEXT

- TABLE

- VIDEO

- AUDIO

- INDEX

description.zh: 数据集名称，支持模糊搜索
description.en: The dataset name. Supports fuzzy search.

The sort order. Default: Desc.

Valid values:

- Asc: Ascending.

- Desc: Descending.

description.zh:
数据集来源，取值有
- DataWorks
- PAI
description.en:
The dataset source. Valid values:

- DataWorks

- PAI
The number of entries per page. Default: 10. Maximum: 100.

description.zh: 排序字段，默认为 CreateTime(创建时间)
description.en:
The sort field. Default: CreateTime.

Valid values:

- ModifyTime: Modification time.

- CreateTime: Creation time.

- Name

description.zh:
存储类型，可多选，当前支持
- OSS  对象存储
- NAS  通用型NAS文件存储
- EXTREMENAS  极速型NAS文件存储
- DLF_LANCE  数据湖构建
- CPFS  CPFS文件存储
- BMCPFS 智算CPFS文件存储
- MAXCOMPUTE  MaxCompute表
description.en:
The storage type. Multiple selections are allowed. Supported values:

- OSS

- NAS: General-purpose NAS file systems

- EXTREMENAS: Extreme NAS file systems

- DLF\_LANCE: Data Lake Formation

- CPFS: Cloud Parallel File Storage

- BMCPFS: CPFS for Lingjun

- MAXCOMPUTE: MaxCompute table

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-datasets --project-id 251363 --origin DataWorks --name test_dataset --data-type-list COMMON --storage-type-list NAS --creator-id 12103XXX46492139 --sort-by CreateTime --order Asc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListDatasets --region cn-hangzhou --Origin DataWorks --Order Asc --DataTypeList COMMON --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --CreatorId 12103XXX46492139 --SortBy CreateTime --ProjectId 251363 --StorageTypeList NAS --Name test_dataset
